rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when supplying a person, group, vehicle, or operation with necessary equipment or resources.

example.english: We equip the rescue team with enough first-aid supplies.
example.traditional: 我哋為救援隊配備咗足夠嘅急救用品。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wai6 gau3 wun4 deoi2 pui3 bei6 zo2 zuk1 gau3 ge3 gap1 gau3 jung6 ban2

rows.note: Use this when equipping someone with a skill means teaching and practising that skill.

example.english: The company uses hands-on training to equip new staff with the skills they need.
example.traditional: 公司安排師傅訓練新人，等佢哋學識做呢份工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 si1 fu2 fan3 lin6 san1 jan4 dang2 keoi5 dei6 hok6 sik1 zou6 ne1 fan6 gung1
